_meta.why: facilityType describes the room, not the front door. These buildings hold ordinary classrooms that a random undergraduate should not be routed into, so the rooms are absent from the shipped index rather than ranked low. This is a judgement about access, not a measurement, which is why it ships as its own dated file the app can surface and a later term can revise without a rebuild.
_meta.measured: 40 rooms in the Autumn 2026 harvest pass the facilityType filter inside these buildings: 34 shown and 6 secondary. The three Wooster rooms named in room-safety.mjs OFF_CAMPUS are separate and are already dropped by the building join.
